pages.title: Who this is for
pages.text: This volume is not for ordinary players. It is written for $(bold)modpack authors$() and $(bold)server owners$() who want to reshape the mod's content $(italic)without editing source code$().$(br2)The book has four parts: what you can change (config and data packs), how the mechanics are calculated, how to write recipes, and step-by-step tutorials.

pages.title: Where the files are
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Config$(): $(thing)config/flavor_immersed_daily_argo-common.toml$() and $(thing)config/flavor_immersed_daily_argo-economy.toml$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)Data packs$(): $(thing)data/<namespace>/...$(); the mod's own content lives in $(thing)data/flavor_immersed_daily_argo/$().$(br)$(li)$(bold)Book text$(): $(thing)assets/flavor_immersed_daily_argo/patchouli_books/$() — only needed if you want to rewrite these pages.

pages.title: Making edits apply
pages.text: $(li)Data packs: save the file and run $(thing)/reload$(). Economy products, shops, fishing codex and weight data are re-sent by the server after reload; clients do not need to restart.$(br)$(li)Config: restart the game, or leave and re-enter the world in single player. On a server, restart it.$(br)$(li)Only the hard-coded constants (see Mechanics) require a recompile.

pages.title: Three habits
pages.text: $(li)Back up the world and the $(thing)data$() folder before touching anything — a missing comma is the most common mistake.$(br)$(li)A JSON file whose name starts with $(thing)_$() is skipped by the loader. Renaming a file is the fastest way to temporarily disable content.$(br)$(li)Always test in a single-player world before pushing to a live server.
